arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2019-02-01'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions dated in January 2019, whether or not they carry a fraud label.
assumptions: January 2019 is 2019-01-01 up to but not including 2019-02-01, which is within the data range (2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31).
All transactions are counted, including those without a fraud label and those with negative amounts.
